executors.description: Read group business metadata or execute caller SQL using the deterministic TiDB/MySQL gateway and connection configuration bundled in this Skill. No external project or model workflow.

actions.description: Start data questions here: retrieve maintained business terms, source-bound entity objects, source/metric candidates, reasons, ambiguities and gaps before domain planning. Model hypotheses may drive bounded read-only probes; a user-supplied physical code does not require name resolution. No live schema scan or business SQL.

inputs.name: request-json
inputs.description: Metadata JSON: question; optional limit/offset/catalog_revision. Candidates are not semantic confirmation.

inputs.name: output
inputs.description: Workspace JSON evidence path.

actions.result: nl2sql.semantic-metadata/v1 with catalog_revision and explicit schema_verification. Full result saved on disk. Read the small inline content, otherwise use exact file pointers.

actions.description: Expand or narrow ranked table candidates without fetching full schemas. Supports pagination; ranking never changes query authority.

inputs.name: request-json
inputs.description: Metadata JSON: question; optional limit/offset/catalog_revision.

inputs.name: output
inputs.description: Workspace JSON evidence path.

actions.result: nl2sql.semantic-metadata/v1 with catalog_revision and explicit schema_verification. Full result saved on disk. Read the small inline content, otherwise use exact file pointers.

inputs.name: output
inputs.description: Workspace JSON evidence path.

actions.result: nl2sql.semantic-metadata/v1 with catalog_revision and explicit schema_verification. Full result saved on disk. Read the small inline content, otherwise use exact file pointers.

inputs.name: request-json

inputs.name: output

actions.result: nl2sql.semantic-metadata/v1 with catalog_revision and explicit schema_verification. Full result saved on disk. Read the small inline content, otherwise use exact file pointers.

inputs.name: output

actions.result: nl2sql.semantic-metadata/v1 with catalog_revision and explicit schema_verification. Full result saved on disk. Read the small inline content, otherwise use exact file pointers.

inputs.name: output

actions.description: After source selection, batch fetch metric-dependent and relevant live fields, entities, periods and relationships; returns a source-signature-bound plan_seed. Use it to generate SQL in this Run.

inputs.name: request-json
inputs.description: Metadata JSON: question, source_ids:[id]; optional metric_refs:[{source_id,metric_id}], term_refs:[{term_id,binding_id}], columns:[{source_id,names:[field]}], catalog_revision. See references/retrieval-contract.md.

inputs.name: output
inputs.description: Workspace JSON evidence path.

actions.result: nl2sql.semantic-metadata/v1 with catalog_revision and explicit schema_verification. Full result saved on disk. Read the small inline content, otherwise use exact file pointers.

actions.description: Autonomously inspect bounded source-local values and frequencies, optionally within entity/metric filters and grouped with related fields (e.g. time type and unit). Use current live fields. Only entity-identity probes require identifying the entity object first. Observations are exploration evidence, never a global definition or a final business answer.

inputs.name: source-id
inputs.description: Source ID from the current catalog.

inputs.name: field
inputs.description: Physical field name from the current source schema.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Maximum distinct values to observe, 1..200.

inputs.name: request-json
inputs.description: Optional JSON: filters:[{field,operator:eq|in|like,values:[scalar]}] combined with AND; group_by:[up to 3 related physical fields]. All fields belong to this source, SQL is built by the gateway.

inputs.name: output
inputs.description: Workspace value-probe JSON path.

actions.result: Source-local observations with probe_ref, source signature, filters, truncated and query evidence. For a declared missing period encoding, pass a complete probe_ref in query_plan.probe_refs; the gateway refreshes and validates exact scope. Never use machine observations as HIL decision_refs.

actions.description: Read the configured group scenario identity.

inputs.name: output
inputs.description: Workspace JSON result path.

actions.result: Group scenario identity and persisted file receipt.

actions.description: Read all authorized source identities and compact metric/term identities for one explicitly selected scenario. Full definitions are retrieved by question or selected source.

inputs.name: output
inputs.description: Workspace JSON result path.

actions.result: Business metadata only; no model settings or connection credentials.

actions.description: 探查当前来源中与用户提及相符的实体候选。结果只作为 candidate_lookup 证据，不生成精确绑定、selection_evidence 或 selected_codes；确认候选后再调用 resolve-entity 做规范名称精确查证。

inputs.name: request-json
inputs.description: JSON with mention, source_id and entity_id from current catalog; optional limit 1..100.

actions.result: nl2sql.entity-candidates/v1 with fuzzy candidate_lookup evidence and empty selected_codes.

actions.description: Bind a matched business term and its interpreted canonical name to a source-specific entity definition. Query the exact canonical name and return all candidate codes, lookup evidence and an entity query_plan. Do not retry with the original short-name LIKE.

inputs.name: request-json
inputs.description: JSON with mention, matched_term, canonical_name, source_id and entity_id from current catalog definitions.

inputs.name: output
inputs.description: Workspace entity-resolution JSON path; reuse this file as the query plan.

actions.result: resolved, ambiguous or unmatched; complete candidates and lookup query evidence. Ambiguous plans have no selected codes and require an explicit selection.

actions.description: Execute a whitelisted, catalog-derived fast lookup for scenario table row counts or one source's multiple dimension counts. The gateway selects authorized tables and fields, creates the query plan, combines dimensions into one SQL, and returns complete evidence.

inputs.name: request-json
inputs.description: JSON kind=scenario_table_counts, or kind=source_dimension_counts with source_label, dimension_labels and count_label. Caller SQL and physical identifiers are not accepted.

inputs.name: output
inputs.description: Workspace query result JSON path.

actions.result: Complete nl2sql.query-result/v1 with deterministic_answer=true, verified query plan and one combined SQL result.

actions.description: Execute SQL with query_plan. Verify source, metric and time bindings; verify entity codes only when entity_bindings are present. SQL may filter entities with entity_bindings empty. get-query-context, entity-resolution and execute-wrapper JSON are deterministically unwrapped.

inputs.name: request-json
inputs.description: JSON {sql,params,query_plan:{context_id:returned_id,...optional_bindings}}. Do not rebuild plan_seed. For missing period encoding add probe_refs:[returned_probe_ref] from a complete scoped probe and preserve its exact filters. Human decisions only in decision_refs. Do not also pass --query-plan.

inputs.name: query-plan
inputs.description: Workspace query-plan, entity-resolution, or get-query-context JSON. Context artifacts expose context_id; preserve that immutable context instead of rebuilding semantic bindings.

inputs.name: output
inputs.description: Workspace query result JSON path.

actions.result: Complete query evidence with query_plan and plan_verification. Binding mismatches are rejected before data SQL execution and identify the failed association.

executors.description: Run bounded, deterministic post-processing over an existing query result. No database, credential, network or caller-code access.

actions.description: 对同一 Run 已成功保存的查询结果做有限、确定性的分组后处理。只允许 group_summary 及声明式 count/sum/min/max/avg/median/distinct_count；不连接数据库、不读取凭据、不修改输入结果、不执行模型或调用者代码。

inputs.name: request-json
inputs.description: JSON：input 为 @workspace 下已有查询结果，operation=group_summary，group_by 为 1..4 个字段，aggregations 为声明式聚合，limit 不超过 2000。

inputs.name: output
inputs.description: Workspace JSON 结果路径。

actions.result: nl2sql.data-file/v1 with bounded computed rows and an input hash; this is derived evidence and never replaces the source query result.

executors.description: Create a bounded final file from an already returned and verified data-analysis Result. This executor never queries the database.

actions.description: Build the explicitly requested final file with the application-owned generator. First write one data-agent.file-export/v1 JSON spec from the existing query Result; never put SQL, credentials or executable code in the spec.

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: One of xlsx, csv, docx, pdf, pptx, html or markdown.

inputs.name: spec
inputs.description: Workspace data-agent.file-export/v1 JSON specification produced from the existing query Result.

inputs.name: output
inputs.description: Final workspace output path whose extension matches the format.

actions.result: Bounded file receipt with format, output path, byte size and SHA-256. Bind the same output path to the delivery target and run artifact acceptance.
